text: dsh-preview-market 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的预览插件目录与管理面板，在“设置 → 预览市场”和“设置 → 插件”中展示可用条目及当前 profile 已安装的插件。它读取目录和安装清单，显示格式、版本与主机要求；检测更新后可通过 dsh-market 安装、更新或启停插件，也可复制 dsh CLI 安装命令。预览插件仍作为独立 Loader 条目管理。本插件需要 DSH 主机及 profile 配置；没有代码证据表明需要额外 API Key。

dsh-preview-market adds a catalog panel to DSH Web Settings. It lists preview plugins and installed profile entries with formats and versions. Users can install or update through dsh-market, copy a dsh CLI command, or toggle installed entries. Each preview plugin remains independent.
想在 DSH 设置里浏览可用的文件预览插件，并查看支持的格式。
帮我看看当前 profile 已安装哪些预览插件，哪些有更新。
I want to discover and manage preview plugins from the DSH settings screen.
dsh-preview-market 的功能「浏览预览插件目录」：在设置页展示目录条目、说明、类型或文件格式、版本及主机要求，并提供发现和已安装两个视图。打开预览市场页面后自动读取目录与当前 profile 的安装清单。
dsh-preview-market 的功能「管理预览插件」：对目录中的插件生成对应 profile 的 dsh CLI 安装命令并支持复制；存在 dsh-market 时可发起安装、更新及启停操作，已安装条目还提供配置入口提示。

dsh-preview-market README · dsh-preview-market：A **vertical preview market** for DeepSeek Harness. A top-level settings section (and a Settings → Plugins tab) lists the preview plugins that exist for DSH, shows which ones the active profile already has, and hands installs/updates to [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) or the official `dsh plugin` command.

dsh-preview-market README · dsh-preview-market：It is not a general plugin market, and it does not implement previews itself: every preview plugin stays an independent Loader entry with its own repository, version and settings. The market only provides the catalog, the installed view and the entry points.

dsh-preview-market README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-preview-market
```

Open **Settings → Preview market** (the same panel is also under **Settings → Plugins**).

Upgrading from `dsh-media-preview` / `dsh-blend-preview` / `dsh-stl-preview`? See [MIGRATION.md](MIGRATION.md).

dsh-preview-market README · What it does：- **Catalog** — first-party preview plugins with their formats, host requirements and versions.
- **Installed view** — reads the active profile's `package.json`, matching catalog names by default and honouring a package's `dsh.preview` manifest when present; never imports child plugin code.
- **Install / update** — delegates to `dsh-market` when it is present. Without it, the card shows the exact `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <package>@<version>` command to copy.
- **Independent plugins** — media, Blender and STL remain separate packages; this page has no renderer and does not merge their code.
dsh-preview-market README · Preview market：The top-level **Settings → Preview market** section, next to dsh-market, with the Discover / Installed tabs and the current four entries:
dsh-preview-market README · Installed cards and controls：Each installed entry keeps the same controls: status, copyable install command, enable/disable through dsh-market, and a Configure entry.

dsh-preview-market README · Current preview plugins：| Plugin | Opens | Formats | Host requirement |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`dsh-preview-media`](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-preview-media) | Video and audio | mp4/mov/webm/mkv + mp3/flac/wav/… | — |
| [`dsh-preview-blender`](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-preview-blender) | Blender scenes | `.blend` | Blender 3.6+ |
| [`dsh-preview-stl`](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-preview-stl) | STL meshes | `.stl` | — |
| [`dsh-preview-snip`](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-preview-snip) | Tool: circle a region or quote text | no file extension | — |

dsh-preview-market README · dsh-preview-media：Play video/audio in the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route. Desktop seeking uses the token-guarded loopback origin; `0.1.5` also retries the authenticated route when the loopback reports a code-4 media error.
dsh-preview-market README · dsh-preview-blender：A `.blend` file is exported to a cached GLB by Blender headless, then rendered in a dependency-free WebGL viewport with scene statistics.
dsh-preview-market README · dsh-preview-stl：STL is parsed in the browser; the viewport reports size, volume, surface area and watertightness without uploading the mesh.
dsh-preview-market README · dsh-preview-snip：A preview-header tool: drag a rectangle over an image/PDF to attach a PNG, or quote selected text into the composer.

dsh-preview-market README · Catalog (0.1.10)：Every plugin is **one file** under [`catalog/plugins/`](catalog/plugins/), named `<owner>__<repo>.json`. A third-party submission adds exactly one file plus the regenerated `catalog.json` snapshot — no market code change. The Host loads, validates and merges all files at startup; the format and PR steps are in [`catalog/README.md`](catalog/README.md).

dsh-preview-market README · Catalog (0.1.10)：Preview entries use `kind: "media"` or `"three"` and declare their extensions; `dsh-preview-snip` uses `kind: "tool"`, which has no file extensions and is displayed as a tool card.

dsh-preview-market README · Configuration：Settings → Plugins → Preview market (namespace `preview-market`):

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Register the routes, the top-level section and the Settings → Plugins tab. |
| `routeRoot` | `/api/preview-market` | Authenticated route root; must stay under `/api`. |
| `profileDir` | `""` | Profile to inspect. Empty uses the Host `profileContext`, then `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop`. |
| `debug` | `false` | Reserved for request diagnostics. |

dsh-preview-market README · Examples：- [`examples/profile-overrides.yml`](examples/profile-overrides.yml) — a safe starting point for per-profile overrides (media chunk size, Blender path, STL unit scale).
- [`catalog.json`](catalog.json) — machine-readable snapshot of the shipped catalog, enforced by a unit test.

dsh-preview-market README · Development：```sh
node --test test/*.test.js
```

`catalog.json` is a machine-readable snapshot of the shipped catalog; regenerate it with `npm run catalog:write` and keep it in sync (a test enforces this).

Settings-section end-to-end (requires a running host with the plugin installed):

```sh
node scripts/e2e-section.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --token <token>
```

Settings-tab end-to-end (requires a running host with the plugin installed):

dsh-preview-market README · Development：```sh
node scripts/e2e-settings.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --token <token>
```

Fallback install/copy check (requires a profile where one catalog entry is not installed):

```sh
node scripts/e2e-fallback.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --token <token>
```

Toggle/configure check (requires dsh-market and an installed STL preview):

```sh
node scripts/e2e-toggle.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --token <token>
```
dsh-preview-market README · Development：The client bundle is `lib/client.js` (classic `__ModuleLoader__.load` factory, no build step).

dsh-preview-market README · Status：`0.1.10` — top-level Settings → Preview market section with Discover / Installed tabs, plus the Settings → Plugins tab. The catalog is one file per plugin under `catalog/plugins/` (preview plugins and tool entries such as the preview snip), so third-party entries are a one-file PR. Enable/disable goes through dsh-market. One-click install requires the package in the connected dsh-market registry; otherwise use the copyable command. Configuration stays in each child plugin's own Settings → Plugins page.
